en.html:
Bold scheme, certainly. Hands practically empty, and these two would challenge an enormous military government and make it change its nature.

What chance did it have? That I could not say. But sit quietly and watch, and when the time suited the occupation forces, they would move against Rokuhara. Either succeed and put all Yamato under occupation,

or lose, leaving Rokuhara the sole ruler. One of those futures for the country. Savage fighting first, whichever future was chosen.

No, one more possibility was there. Neither side won; the war went on and on. That was the worst of the lot.

Aaiye, choose your future. Foreign masters, domestic masters, or endless war. Bloodshed included with every selection. Such a generous choice, and still the ungrateful people wanted something else.

If we refused those futures and wanted even a comparatively decent one, some action had to be taken. Call the Prince and the Chief's plan reckless, haan, reckless it was. Call it reasonable, and that also I could not deny.

Baithe raho, toh bhi bill aayega. Sit doing nothing, and the cost would come anyway. That was the difficulty. Refusing this particular recklessness did not mean the world would kindly leave us out of the next one.

What chance did it have? That I could not say. But sit quietly and watch, and when the time suited the occupation forces, they would move against Rokuhara. Either succeed and put all Yamato under occupation,

or lose, leaving Rokuhara the sole ruler. One of those futures for the country. Savage fighting first, whichever future was chosen.

No, one more possibility was there. Neither side won; the war went on and on. That was the worst of the lot.

Aaiye, choose your future. Foreign masters, domestic masters, or endless war. Bloodshed included with every selection. Such a generous choice, and still the ungrateful people wanted something else.

If we refused those futures and wanted even a comparatively decent one, some action had to be taken. Call the Prince and the Chief's plan reckless, haan, reckless it was. Call it reasonable, and that also I could not deny.

ja.html:
雄略と呼ぶべきだろう。
　徒手空拳に等しい身で強大な軍事政権に挑み、その
体質を改めさせようというのであるから。

　成就する見込みの程は知れない。
　が、何もせず情況を見守れば、進駐軍は時節が到来
次第六波羅の排除に乗り出し――これを遂げて大和を
完全な占領下に置くか。

　それとも六波羅が勝利を得て大和唯一の支配権者と
なりおおせるか。
　この国はどちらかの結末を迎えるだろう。……苛烈
な交戦の後に。

　いや、可能性はもう一つある。
　両者の相克に決着がつかず、延々と戦争が続く――
という最悪の展開も起こり得る。

　喜ばしからざる運命を拒否し、<ruby>比較的<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>にでも良好な
未来を手に入れたいと望むなら、やはり行動は必要だ。
　親王と署長、この二人の構想は、暴挙といえば暴挙
であったが至当といえば至当に違いなかった。

en.html:
This plan could save Yamato. Believing that required no great effort.

It would not be easy. There would be discrepancies, oversights, difficulties enough. Still, the Prince made one feel that he might manage it. And he had the Chief beside him.

More to the point, had I produced a better plan myself? I had not. On what grounds, then, was I entitled to dismiss his?

From no direction could I call the Prince wrong.

...Very well. Could I do it?

Attack Moriuji Ashikaga and take his life?

en.html: Save many good people. Kill one bad man. ............That was what I had already done. Again, again, so many times. To stop Silver Star, that calamity, from spreading, I had cut down warrior after warrior carrying her Eggs. Remove one evil. Leave many good. Same thing only. Where was the difference? Both were,◆ ————nothing but self-righteousness. For the country. For the people... Take off that good-looking outer skin, and underneath the actual thing was visible. I was not saying something foolish like the Prince secretly wanted personal profit. But choose to crush an opponent through violence, and whatever the motive, self-righteousness was what we were doing. For the sake of my good, call his good evil and bury it. One sword, one killing: this is the Balance of Good and Evil. My answer was settled.

ja.text:
多くの善き人々を救うために、
　一人の悪しき者を殺す。

　…………それは、

　俺が既に幾度も、幾度も、繰り返してきた所業だ。

　銀星号わざわいの拡大を阻止すべく、
〝卵〟に寄生された武者を幾人となく斬り殺した。

　一悪を断ち多善を残す。

　まるで同じだ。
　何処にも違いなど無い。

　どちらも、◆

　――――独善に過ぎない。

　国のため。人のため……
　そんな聞こえの良い外面かわを一枚剥けば、そこに真実
の姿が覗く。

　親王の動機が実は私利私欲だとか、間の抜けた事を
言うつもりはない。
　しかし、対立者を暴力で挫くという道を選ぶのなら、
動機がどうあれそれはやはり独善の行いなのだ。

　我の善のため、
　彼の善を悪と称して葬る。

　一剣一殺是善悪相殺いっけんいっさつこれぜんあくそうさい。

　俺の返答は定まった。

en.html:
And while thinking all this, Moriuji Ashikaga I could kill without objection?

Both were human.
Ordinary people, both. Good and evil in them, achievements and sins.

From the place where I stood, the Chief's good was what I saw most. Moriuji's evil was what I saw most. That much only. Stand elsewhere, and the view would be different.

Still, call one evil and cut him down; call the other good and let him live.

—Self-righteousness.

Muramasa had said it. Self-righteousness was the root of conflict. It justified killing, kept the killing going without end.

Haan.
That was exactly right.

ja.html:
そう思う一方、足利護氏は構わず斬れるのか。

　同じ人間である。
　善あり悪あり功あり罪ある、同じ<ruby>只人<rt>ただびと</rt></ruby>である。

　単に俺の立つ位置からは署長の善ばかりが、護氏の
悪ばかりが目立つというだけに過ぎない。
　異なる位置に立つ者には、異なる見方があるだろう。

　なのに一方のみ悪として斬り、もう一方を善として
生かすのは、

　――独善である。

　村正は言った。
　独善こそ争いの根源。殺し合いを正当化し、際限も
なく続けさせる元凶――と。

　そう。
　それは、その通りなのだ。
